questions.q: According to the class, when was man introduced to eating meat?
questions.explain: This is the introduction of man eating meat; before it the animals and man were vegetarian.

questions.q: What does 'whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed' show about the law?
choices: It was given only to Noah's sons
It was done away with by Christ
It stood long before Moses, so it cannot be dismissed as the law of Moses
questions.explain: Christ came not to destroy the law but to fulfil (Matthew 5:17-18).

questions.q: What is the token of the covenant between the Most High and the earth?
choices: The bow in the cloud, the rainbow

questions.q: Where did Ham dwell after the flood?
questions.explain: Ham dwelt in Africa, Shem toward Arabia, Japheth in Europe. Canaan, Ham's son, dwelt in the land later called Israel.

questions.q: How did Noah know what Ham had done while he slept?
choices: He saw it in the morning
The Most High revealed it to him, as He reveals His secrets to His prophets
questions.explain: God speaks in a dream, in a vision of the night (Job 33:14-16); He reveals His secret unto His servants the prophets (Amos 3:7).
